山姆与老城区的计划(Sam and the the old town Plan): 一篇关于旅行出行的A2短文:山姆与莉莉的经历和小计划。
There are always many people at the old town. Last Tuesday, Sam and Lily went to the airport. Sam is going to travel to Toronto in May. Chelmsford grew quickly after the railway arrived.
The weather was snowy that day. Sam hopes to visit Toronto one day. Life is full of small surprises. The concierge booked our taxi.
Sam and Lily had great fun there. Sam is reading a book about science. Lily is interested in dancing. Airport transfer is included in the price.
Lily's birthday is in May. Both of them like soup and coffee. The airport is one of the best places in the city.
